नैवि(बि)ड्यम्
 
__1 Compactness, closeness, thickness, denseness. 
__2 Substance. 
__3 A continuous sound.
An offering of eatables presented to a deity or idol.
__1 Any vessel or implement forming part of domestic furniture; नैबेशिकं सर्वगुणोपपन्नं ददाति वै यस्तु नरो द्विजाय [[

.]] 
__2 A present to a Brāhmaṇa householder, e. g. a girl or ornaments given with her.
